verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Tap to Pay on iPhone solution that you build under a 'mobile-ios/build' docs path, which lets an iPhone accept contactless in-person payments on the Adyen platform. Marketing also says compatible smartphones or tablets can become Tap to Pay checkouts with no extra hardware. That covers the iOS side of embedding payments in your own app, but the evidence never explicitly names an official SDK or confirms an Android equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official mobile SDK, Android SDK evidence, integration depth (installation, APIs, supported devices), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
